CC/SA/HA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PAA - MAY 19, 2020 - 6:30PM & 7:00PM
CC/SA/HA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PAA - MAY 19, 2020 - 6:30PM & 7:00PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, MAY 19, 2020
06:30 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1484
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
IMPORTANT PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY MESSAGE REGARDING PARTICIPATION AT CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
As a result of the COVID-19 emergency, and resulting orders and direction from the President of the United States, the Governor of the State of California, and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health, as well as the City of Palmdale emergency declaration, the public will not be permitted to physically attend the City Council meeting. Councilmembers may choose to participate via conference call.
How to Observe the Meeting:
1) Spectrum local access Channel 27
2) Online live webcast at cityofpalmdale.org.
How to Submit Public Comments through Palmdale eComments on this Agenda:
Note: Public Comments submitted will become part of the official meeting record.
1)Go to the Agendas & Minutes webpage at https://cityofpalmdale.org/310/City-Council-Meetings and find this meeting under Upcoming Events; 2) Click on the eComment button; and 3) Scroll through the agenda to find the agenda item for which you would like to provide a comment and submit your comment.
Please note: The City Council is making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and other applicable laws regulating the conduct of public meetings in order to maximize transparency and public access.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.
1. CALL TO ORDER 6:30 P.M. CLOSED SESSION MEETING.
2. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
3. PUBLIC COMMENTS RECEIVED ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM 4.1.
4. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of a Council discussion and to confer with the City Manager and Personnel Manager in connection with the pending retirement of City Attorney, Matthew Ditzhazy, including a discussion of replacement of the city attorney.
This closed session is necessary because a public discussion of this item, prior to a complete discussion by the Council of a course of action to replace the city attorney, would be prejudicial to the City.
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54957 and 54957.6.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
7. ADJOURN 6:30 P.M. CLOSED SESSION MEETING.
8. CALL TO ORDER 7:00 ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING.
9. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
10. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
11. PUBLIC COMMENTS RECEIVED ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEM NOS. 12.1 AND 12.2, PRESENTATION ITEM NO. 13.1, AND NON-AGENDA ITEMS.
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar.
12. CONSENT CALENDAR:
12.1 Approve Cost Sharing agreement between the City of Palmdale and the Antelope Valley Mall, LLC/QIC Properties US, Inc. for Deputy Services, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and all necessary documents, Agreement No. A-7004. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: Approve Cost Sharing agreement between the City of Palmdale and the Antelope Valley Mall, LLC/QIC Properties US, Inc. for Deputy Services A-7004
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 12.1
12.2 Approve the First Amendment to Legal Services Agreement with Richards Watson & Gershon increasing the contract maximum by $250,000, Agreement No. A-6240. (Staff Reference: City Attorney Ditzhazy)
Staff Recommendation: Approve the First Amendment to Legal Services Agreement with Richards Watson & Gershon, Agreement No. A-6240.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 12.2
13. PRESENTATION:
13.1 FY 2020-21 Budget Workshop. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Kang)
Staff Recommendation: Receive and provide input on the proposed Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget and set a public hearing for adoption at the June 16, 2020 City Council meeting. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority vote to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 13.1
PowerPoint Presentation
14. SPECIAL REPORT:
14.1 Discussion and Possible Action regarding COVID-19 issues and related Orders. (Staff Reference: City Manager Murphy)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 14.1
15. ADJOURNMENT.
